zoe-sales: Heads-up: MeridianCare (EU hospital chain) wants one consolidated POC evidence bundle. They listed: SOC 2 Type II excerpts, ISO 27001 cert, EU network/topology diagram, signed pen-test attestation (they prefer a signed company letter), SSO/SAML configuration summary, data residency statement, and a short pricing note: Dedicated vs Private impact. POC kickoff aimed for Sep 6. Can someone own and confirm ETA? @olga-security? :eyes:

mike-ae: Clarifying q to PO: full SOC2 report or excerpts (control matrix + system description)? Also whether they require redaction of contact details. I'll ask now.

olga-security: I can pull SOC2 excerpts, ISO cert, network diag filtered to EU region, and SSO/SAML summary. For signed pen-test attestation: we have a standard template indicating "no critical findings as of [scan date]" but legal must sign. Need to know if they want "no critical or high" language. Expect ~2 business days after scope + recipient confirmed.

proofpack-bot: Created proofpack workspace: s3://proofpacks/meridiancare/1789012345/
Presign (48h): curl -X PUT "https://uploads.redwood/proofpacks/1789012345?sig=mer123" -F file=@evidence.zip
(Do not post creds in channel) :lock:

rahul-infra: We can provision 3 static IPs for external scans within 24h once an owner is assigned. Dedicated for POC adds approx +$7k/mo to evaluation credits; Private requires onboarding (~10 business days) and a one-time fee (~$12k). If they want KMS separation details for Private, we can include a short diagram. Staging IPs available 24-48h after owner.

gina-legal: We can sign the attestation on letterhead. Need recipient name and exact wording. Also confirm NDA permits sending signed artifacts. Typical turnaround: draft same day, signature next business day. If they insist on vendor third-party report rather than company attestation we may need additional vendor permissions.

zoe-sales: Target: deliver final bundle to PO by Sep 1 so procurement has time before Sep 6 kickoff. Mike please confirm Type II vs Type I and redaction preferences with PO today. Olga please own artifact pull and upload to the proofpack. Rahul please reserve IP placeholders and add to manifest. Gina I'll DM recipient contact if they want signed letter.

mike-ae: Pinged PO. They confirmed Type II excerpts and said redaction of vendor contacts ok. They prefer wording: "no critical or high findings as of [scan date]" for attestation. Also asked for our POC vuln SLA and whether we will remediate criticals during the POC or provide mitigations.

olga-security: Noted. Our POC vuln SLA: we provide mitigation guidance within 24-48h for criticals and patch scheduling for highs; we do not usually backport fixes into ephemeral images but can coordinate temporary controls. I'll include a short SLA blurb in the packet.

gina-legal: Acknowledged. Once Olga posts draft attestation include recipient email and I'll route for signature. If they want remediation commitments tied to contract, flag Sales.

zoe-sales: Thanks all  post blockers here. If timeline shifts ping me directly. :rocket:
